objective: Paired fresh-seed comparison of exact e1p4 and the two b01d components plus their combination against all 75 official 2025 teams.

design.pairing: Each panel has a new seed and a fresh random partition of the complete 75-team field; all four arms share the exact same panel seed and cohorts.
design.metric: Candidate team points divided by battles, averaged over all 75-team field contexts.
design.components: e1p4 control; A decoy only; B band shift only; combined b01d.
